import { Icon } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/icon";

import {
  Menubar,
  MenubarContent,
  MenubarGroup,
  MenubarItem,
  MenubarMenu,
  MenubarSeparator,
  MenubarShortcut,
  MenubarTrigger,
  MenubarList,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/menubar";

export const MenubarIcons = () => (
  <Menubar className="w-72">
    <MenubarMenu>
      <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
      <MenubarContent>
        <MenubarList>
          <MenubarItem>
            <Icon name="file-01" />
            New File <MenubarShortcut hotkey="Mod+N" />
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem>
            <Icon name="folder-01" />
            Open Folder
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarSeparator />
          <MenubarItem>
            <Icon name="save" />
            Save <MenubarShortcut hotkey="Mod+S" />
          </MenubarItem>
        </MenubarList>
      </MenubarContent>
    </MenubarMenu>
    <MenubarMenu>
      <MenubarTrigger>More</MenubarTrigger>
      <MenubarContent>
        <MenubarList>
          <MenubarGroup>
            <MenubarItem>
              <Icon name="settings-01" />
              Settings
            </MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem>
              <Icon name="help-circle" />
              Help
            </MenubarItem>
            <MenubarSeparator />
            <MenubarItem variant="error">
              <Icon name="trash" />
              Delete
            </MenubarItem>
          </MenubarGroup>
        </MenubarList>
      </MenubarContent>
    </MenubarMenu>
  </Menubar>
);
